scenarios.scenario: Dismiss Docking Positions from the expanded Constrain title menu

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with an active editable `Sketch1` in the MCAD Software
the full Sketch ribbon is visible
the Constrain additional command area is open
the user right-clicks the lower Constrain title
the title context menu offers Ribbon Appearance, Show Panels, Customize User Commands, Undock Ribbon and Docking Positions
the Constrain additional command area remains open
the user opens Docking Positions
Top is checked and Left and Right are available
the user presses Escape
the Docking Positions submenu closes and the title context menu remains open
the Constrain additional command area remains open
the user presses Escape again
the title context menu and Constrain additional command area close
the editable sketch remains active and unchanged

scenarios.scenario: Open the 3D Model Modify panel expansion with keyboard tips

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible with the Modify panel
the Modify panel's additional command area is closed
the user presses Alt, then M, then Y
the Modify additional command area opens below the ribbon over the browser area
Move Bodies, Bend Part and Copy Object are visible
the solid body and model browser remain visible
the user clicks the lower Modify title
the additional command area closes and keyboard tips disappear

scenarios.scenario: Pin and unpin the expanded Modify panel

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its visible solid in the MCAD Software
the 3D Model Modify panel is expanded with its pin control unselected
the user selects the pin control
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport
the expanded Modify command area remains visible
the pin control is highlighted
the user selects the pin control again
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport
the additional command area closes
the part remains active

scenarios.scenario: Move a command between the main and expanded areas

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
"Shell" appears in the main area of the 3D Model "Modify" panel
the user right-clicks "Shell" and selects "Move to Expanded Panel"
"Shell" is no longer visible in the main area
the user opens the "Modify" panel expansion
"Shell" appears in the expanded area
the user right-clicks "Shell" in the expanded area
the user selects "Move to Main Panel"
the expansion closes
"Shell" appears again in the main area of the "Modify" panel

scenarios.scenario: Move a grouped control into and out of an expanded panel

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the grouped "Plane" control is in the 3D Model Work Features main panel
the user right-clicks "Plane" and selects "Move to Expanded Panel"
"Plane" is no longer visible in the main panel
the user opens the Work Features expansion
a "Plane" control appears in the expanded area
its context menu offers "Ungroup Commands from Drop-Down Menu"
the user selects "Move to Main Panel" from that context menu
"Plane" returns to the main panel
the part remains active

scenarios.scenario: Launch a command in a panel expansion by keyboard

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full ribbon is displayed
the user presses Alt and then "M"
the 3D Model ribbon displays command key tips
the user presses "Y"
the Modify additional command area opens with key tips for its commands
the user enters "OD"
the Move Bodies dialog opens
the additional command area closes
the user cancels the dialog
the part remains visible without applying the preview

scenarios.scenario: Dismiss a keyboard-opened panel after Escape

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the 3D Model Modify additional command area is open using Alt, "M", and "Y"
its command key tips are visible
the user presses Escape twice
the additional command area and its key tips remain visible
the user clicks the Modify title at the bottom of the additional area
the additional command area and key tips close
the part remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Open the Tools Options additional command area

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the Options additional command area is closed
the user opens the Options additional command area
it appears beneath the Options panel over the viewport
Reset UI Layout is displayed
iLogic Configuration is displayed
the active part and model browser remain visible
the user clicks empty viewport space
the Options additional command area closes
the Tools ribbon and part remain visible

scenarios.scenario: Minimize the ribbon while an expanded panel is pinned

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full Tools ribbon uses the Cycle Through All display policy
the Options additional command area is open and pinned
clicking outside the panel leaves the additional area open
the user activates the ribbon display control
the ribbon shows compact panel buttons
the Options additional command area is no longer visible
the user continues the display cycle to restore the full ribbon
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the Options additional command area is not automatically reopened
the user opens the Options additional command area and clicks outside it
the additional area closes

scenarios.scenario: Keep a pinned expansion open while opening another panel

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the Modify additional command area is open and pinned
the user opens the Simplification additional command area
both the Modify and Simplification additional command areas are visible
the user clicks empty viewport space
the Simplification additional command area closes
the pinned Modify additional command area remains visible
the user unpins Modify and clicks empty viewport space
the Modify additional command area closes
`fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the Modify additional command area is open and pinned
the user opens and pins the Simplification additional command area
the user clicks empty viewport space
both additional command areas remain visible
the user unpins Simplification and clicks empty viewport space
the Simplification additional command area closes
the pinned Modify additional command area remains visible
the user unpins Modify and clicks empty viewport space
the Modify additional command area closes

scenarios.scenario: The panel title does not close a pinned expansion

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the Modify additional command area is open and pinned
the user clicks the Modify title at the bottom of the additional area
the additional command area remains open
the user unpins the additional area
the user clicks its Modify title again
the additional command area closes

scenarios.scenario: Cancel a command launched from a pinned expansion

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the Modify additional command area is open and pinned
the user selects "Move Bodies" from the additional command area
the Move Bodies dialog opens
the user cancels the Move Bodies dialog
the dialog closes without applying the move
the pinned Modify additional command area remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Retain a command in the expanded panel across tab switches

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
Shell is in the Modify main panel
the user moves Shell to the expanded panel using its context menu
the user selects Tools and then returns to 3D Model
Shell is absent from the Modify main panel
the user opens the Modify expanded panel
Shell is available in the expanded panel
the user moves Shell back to the main panel using its context menu
Shell appears in the main Modify panel
the part remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Move an unavailable command to an expanded panel and back

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full Tools ribbon shows an unavailable Copy command in the Clipboard main panel
the user right-clicks Copy and selects "Move to Expanded Panel"
Copy is no longer visible in the Clipboard main panel
the Clipboard panel has an expansion arrow
the user opens the Clipboard expanded panel
Copy appears there as an unavailable command
the user clicks Copy in the expanded panel
the expanded panel remains open and no command opens
the user right-clicks Copy in the expanded panel
the context menu offers "Move to Main Panel" and "Add to Quick Access Toolbar"
the user selects "Move to Main Panel"
the expansion closes
the unavailable Copy command appears in the Clipboard main panel again
the part remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Click the active ribbon tab with an expansion open

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned
the user clicks the selected 3D Model tab
the Modify additional command area closes
the full 3D Model ribbon remains visible
the user opens the Modify additional command area and pins it
the user clicks the selected 3D Model tab
the Modify additional command area remains open
the full 3D Model ribbon remains visible
the user unpins the additional command area
the user clicks the selected 3D Model tab
the additional command area closes
the part remains visible
